sub_questions: Which Google Play Store apps are similar to CrazyGames or Playgama (multi-game instant/HTML5 game portal apps offering many free games in one app)?
What is the user base of each app (Play Store install count band, plus MAU/MAU estimates where available)?
How do these apps rank from largest to smallest user base?
What do CrazyGames and Playgama themselves have on the Play Store (reference baseline)?
required_formats: ranked list/table ordered from largest to smallest user base
required_section_headings: ## 2. Classifica delle app simili sul Play Store per base utenti
## 4. Note su come leggere i numeri

time_periods.primary_source: Google Play Store listing install counts

scope_conditions: apps available on Google Play Store
similar = aggregator/portal of many free casual/HTML5/instant games, not a single game

levers.domain_notes: Sourcing: Google Play Store listings are the primary source for install bands; app-intelligence sites (AppBrain, Sensor Tower, AppMagic, 42matters) and company press releases for MAU and precise install estimates. Install bands (e.g. 10M+) are lower bounds, not active users; distinguish installs from MAU. Recency: current listings (2025-2026) matter most.

rationale.register: user asks to find and list apps ranked by a metric — coverage-shaped
